Maharashtra forms committee to draft Uniform Civil Code law

The Indian state of Maharashtra has formed a 7-member committee to draft a Uniform Civil Code law, with Justice Desai at its helm. The move aims to create a single legal framework for the state's diverse population. This development is part of ongoing efforts to reform India's civil laws and promote social harmony.
